newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber unchanged in noon trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber unchanged in noon trading.

text.p: Indonesian SIR20 rubber offer prices were unchanged in noon trading on Friday with no demand reported, traders said.
"It's quiet until now. I don't hear any deals today but we expect market sentiment to improve next week on talk that buyers will re-enter the market," said one trader.
Traders said offer prices were quoted at 47.50 cents/lb fob Medan for July/August shipment, at 47.00 fob Padang and Surabaya, at 46.75 fob Padang, at 46.875 fob Pontianak and at 46.50 fob Jambi.
